evidence.quote: Tuition Fee for the program: 4.000 USD/semester
Register on the online application site of the University of Pécs

notes: Teaching languages quote is from English-language programme page, which lists 'English, Hungarian' as languages of instruction; value in JSON lists only 'en' because the applicant is applying in the English-language track. Tuition quote is 'US$4,000 per semester' on the programme's English page; apply.pte.hu repeats 'US$4,000 per semester'. Application deadline on apply.pte.hu for 2027/28 is 30 Jun 2027; faculty page states 15 June 2027 (except CSE BSc). Both are shown as evidence; main intake uses the programme's apply.pte.hu deadline. Application fee is US$150 one-time (not included in the facts because it is not tuition). The application channel is university-direct via 'Register on the online application site of the University of Pécs' (https://english.mik.pte.hu/application-step-by-step-1); no Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship route is stated on the supplied pages for this programme. Translation requirement: 'If not, you’ll need official translations accompanied by verified copies of the original documents.' on apply.pte.hu applies to entry qualification documents generally, but no individual document is named with a translation requirement, so translationRequired is left null for all documents.
